newsitem.title: UK: Coats Viyella up as H1 data tops forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Coats Viyella up as H1 data tops forecasts.

text.p: Shares in UK textiles group Coats Viyella Plc rose in early trading on Wednesday, as the group announced higher than expected first half pretax earnings.
Coats Viyella shares were up six pence at 167p in an otherwise flat market. The company said pretax earnings fell to 47 million stg in the first half from 70.8 million a year ago.

Analysts had forecast profits of between 39 and 43.2 million stg. "(An) impressive set of figures and considerably better than the recent ones from Courtaulds (Textiles). We think there's still room for the stock to push higher and will continue to recommend adding it," one marketmaker said.
